DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) of the right posterior canal.

The positive Dix-Hallpike maneuver with horizontal nystagmus in a 70-year-old woman, combined with a negative MRI ruling out central causes, strongly supports this diagnosis. Given your age and history of hearing loss, I will proceed with the Epley maneuver for treatment, but do you have any history of recent head trauma, inner ear surgery, or severe migraine headaches that might complicate this picture?
